knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The figure comes from invoice records for a past period, so it is a fact for that period.
Sensitivity testing ranks inputs by the change in profit each one causes, so the most sensitive inputs are verified first.
A rate from another country is not evidence for an Australian plan. Leave it out of the projection until checked against a current source.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes an assumptions register in which every input has a value, label, basis, source or reason, owner and next check date
Every borrowed rate is replaced with a sourced value or left out
Learner ranks inputs by sensitivity from a stated change, and names the top three to verify with dates
No target is presented as a fact anywhere in the register
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed working document for the lesson, saved with its formulas or calculation notes
Knowledge check result (a quiz result is not a practical competence result)
stopWorkCriteria: Do not use a borrowed rate in a projection without a source
Stop and escalate any input that carries a legal or insurance consequence
Do not share a register containing personal or customer details
